reddit.title: Introducing Material Management in Provincia
reddit.body: We've revamped how you manage resources in Provincia! Instead of a single cost chip, each build tile now displays a detailed **Materials** sheet. This allows you to see stored vs required materials at a glance, with shortages clearly highlighted. No more guessing what you need for your buildings! Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

posts: Exciting news for Provincia players! We've replaced the old cost badge system with a comprehensive **Materials** sheet for all build tiles. Learn more about this update here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Updated Resource Management in Provincia!
steam.body: We're excited to share that we've revamped the way resources are displayed in Provincia! Build tiles now show a detailed **Materials** sheet, allowing you to see exactly what you have and what you need for each building. This update will help streamline your construction process and eliminate confusion. For more information, check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
